basic_details.job_title: CSIR-NEERI Project Assistant II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-NEERI) has announced 1 vacancy for the Project Assistant-II post on a contractual and purely temporary basis, with posting in Nagpur. Candidates holding a B.Sc. in Environmental Science/ Computer science/IT are eligible to apply. The notified pay for the post is Rs. 20,000 + HRA. Eligible applicants can submit their ONLINE application form on the institute website on or before the last date of 20 October 2026. The selection process consists of an Online Interview.

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified separately on the website

how_to_apply: Visit the official CSIR-NEERI website to access the online application portal.
Submit the online application form before the final deadline of 20 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NEERI Project Assistant-II at a Glance

rows.details: Vibration study in respect of Gevra open cast project of South Eastern Coalfields Ltd (a Subsidiary of coal India Limited), Gevra area, Korba, Chhattisgarh - (CNP-3093)
Purely temporary and co-terminus with the project
Rs. 20,000/- + HRA (15% increment after 3 years of experience in the same project)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. in Environmental Science, Computer Science, or IT. Only candidates who have acquired the essential qualification and whose results have been declared (with at least a provisional certificate) are eligible. Result-awaited, final semester appeared, or Ph.D. submitted candidates are not eligible.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected project staff will receive a monthly emolument of Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA, with a 15% increment after 3 years of experience in the same project. Accommodation must be arranged by the candidate, though HRA is admissible as per applicable rules. The appointment is purely temporary, co-terminus with the project, and tenure cannot exceed six or seven years under CSIR rules. The offer is initially issued for the period funds are available.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-NEERI Project Assistant-II
content_sections.text: Visit the official CSIR-NEERI website to access the online application portal. Submit the online application form before the final deadline of 20 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be done through an Online Interview conducted via MS Teams, Skype, or similar platforms. The interview date will be notified separately on the official website. If a large number of applications are received, a screening committee will apply specific criteria to shortlist candidates for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent position at CSIR-NEERI?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, and it does not confer any right to regularization against any CSIR or CSIR-NEERI post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit and is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications. There is no application fee required for candidates.

faq.question: Q3. How will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted online through MS Teams, Skype, or similar platforms, and the specific date will be notified on the official website for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q4. Can final semester or result-awaited students apply for this post?
faq.answer: No, result-awaited, final semester appeared, or Ph.D. submitted candidates are not eligible to apply where minimum essential qualification is mandatory.
